description: Use when you need published weather for NFL team codes on one week. Pass teams, such as ["PIT","HOU"]. Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. Each team includes the published call, kick-window readings, roof, and fantasy line. Unknown codes are returned in notFound. A team with no game that week is bye. Returns one row per code. GDW doesn't connect to fantasy platforms; pass team names.

teams.description: NFL team codes only, such as ["PIT","HOU"].

items.description: NFL team code, such as PIT or HOU.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.
